definitions.explanation: Land at a high elevation, above sea level or above the surrounding terrain. The antonym of {低地|ていち} (lowland). Often used for plateaus and mountainous regions.

examples.japanese: {高地|こうち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧。
examples.english: The air is thin in the highlands.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高地|こうち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{合宿|がっしゅく}→合宿：11901_gasshuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The athletes held a training camp at high altitude.

examples.japanese: アンデス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{高地|こうち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{適応|てきおう}している→適応する：26969_tekiousuru⟧。
examples.english: The people living in the Andean highlands are adapted to the thin air.

notes:
The antonym of ⟦{低地|ていち}→低地：15551_teichi⟧ (lowland). Refers to terrain at high elevation, commonly associated with thin air and athletic altitude training.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高地|こうち}⟦トレーニング→トレーニング：00408_toreeningu⟧: altitude training
- {高地|こうち}⟦{順応|じゅんのう}→順応：14949_junnou⟧: acclimatization to high altitude
- {高地|こうち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{気候|きこう}→気候：00231_kikou⟧: highland climate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{低地|ていち}→低地：15551_teichi⟧: lowland — the direct antonym
- ⟦{高原|こうげん}→高原：05497_kougen⟧: plateau — a flat highland area
